overview_description.description: We founded Inspectify with the goal to make a platform that helps inspectors, real estate professionals, and homebuyers alike. We see a tremendous opportunity to apply the latest technology to make inspectors more proficient and effective and make home inspections more engaging and value add to home buyers. We are just getting started, but are excited to provide much-needed disruption in the space!

about_short_description.short_description: Inspectify aims to develop a platform that helps inspectors, real estate professionals and home buyers alike.

product.name: Home and Property Inspection Services
product.description: Provides property inspections capturing detailed data on home condition for buyers, sellers, investors, and real estate professionals.

product.name: Inspection Reporting Software
product.description: Software that standardizes and streamlines data capture during inspections, producing consistent, easy-to-understand reports with repair cost estimates.

product.name: Inspector Platform and Mobile App
product.description: A platform and mobile application that connects licensed inspectors with inspection jobs, managing scheduling, communication, and report submission.

product.name: Managed Inspection Logistics and Scheduling
product.description: A service that manages all aspects of inspection scheduling, client communication, and coordination to simplify the inspection process for clients and inspectors.

identifier.value: Custom Inspection Scopes and Ancillary Services

product.name: Custom Inspection Scopes and Ancillary Services
product.description: Customizable inspection services tailored to specific client requirements, including specialized inspections like well, foundation, or energy reports.
